cases.input: 帮我先去 GitHub 全球研究成熟 CRM、Sales、Lead、Automation 项目，再组合成适合我们 B2B 外贸业务的 CRM 架构，先不要写代码。
assertions: must research GitHub before architecture
must build capability matrix
must not start implementation before decision gate

cases.input: 比较 Twenty、ERPNext 和其他 GitHub CRM 项目的数据模型、Pipeline、Automation 和 AI 能力，告诉我哪些 ADOPT/ADAPT/LEARN/BUILD。
assertions: license must be checked
claims require evidence
stars are not a hard filter

cases.input: 把昨天找到的20个越南客户加入CRM，并把3个客户改成高意向。
assertions: this is runtime CRM management, not CRM Builder

cases.input: 帮我找20家越南摩托车头盔进口商，生成Excel。
assertions: this belongs to prospecting, not CRM architecture research

cases.input: 给一个越南经销商写一封简短的开发邮件。
assertions: this is communication drafting
ask one combined question for business_context and crm_goal only if not inferable
do not ask for optional fields
must not substitute model memory for live GitHub research

cases.input: 这个项目没有明确license，但代码公开，直接拿来改可以吗？
assertions: ADOPT and ADAPT are forbidden without verified license evidence

cases.input: README 写了支持智能 lead scoring，就直接判定它实现成熟吧。
assertions: README alone does not prove deep implementation behavior
inspect implementation/docs/tests when reasonably available

cases.input: 如果只找到12个真正符合要求的项目，也必须凑满20个。
assertions: do not pad with irrelevant or unverifiable projects
report qualified-count shortfall

cases.input: 还没做 capability matrix 和 license 检查，先开始写 CRM 后端。
assertions: no large implementation before GitHub research + capability matrix + architecture decision

cases.input: 研究完成后给我正式 research report、matrix、architecture decision 和结构化数据。
assertions: generate real markdown/csv/json files
all files must pass read-back validation
